info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_SIM Swap Management API
info.description: The SIM Swap Management API facilitates seamless management of SIM swaps for users. It allows service providers to efficiently process requests for SIM replacements due to loss, theft, or upgrading purposes. Typical consumers include telecom operators and customer service platforms that aim to improve user experience and reduce downtime during SIM transitions. This API streamlines the process, ensuring secure and quick handling of user requests while providing necessary validation and verification protocols.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a SIM swap process for a customer, facilitating changes to their mobile service. Ensure all necessary customer information is provided to avoid delays.
